name: PP FLANGED BALL VALVE
description: PP ball valves are commonly used in industries such as chemical processing, water treatment, agriculture, and pharmaceuticals, among others. They are preferred over other types of valves because of their low cost, easy maintenance, and high performance. They can withstand high pressures and temperatures, and are resistant to many chemicals, acids, and solvents. PP ball valves are also known for their excellent resistance to UV radiation and weathering, making them suitable for outdoor use. (PP) ball valve is a type of valve that is made from polypropylene material. It consists of a hollow ball with a hole in the center that rotates to control the flow of fluids or gases. The ball is held in place by a stem and two seats, which seal the valve when it is closed. The valve is designed to be durable, corrosion-resistant, and lightweight, making it an ideal choice for a wide range of industrial and commercial applications.
